title: Brand Foundation
intro: This section is the bedrock of our brand, outlining our purpose, positioning, and principles. It guides us in all the ways Rectio comes to life: how we look, what we stand for, and how we act in the world.

purpose.heading: Brand Purpose
purpose.subtitle: Guides the enterprise
purpose.p1: Our brand purpose comes from a simple belief: the things people rely on every day should be easy to use and easy to make their own.
purpose.p2: This purpose guides our daily actions and behaviors to best serve our customers, associates, and communities. It is the driving force behind everything we do.

positioning.heading: Company Positioning
positioning.lead: We are a people-led, tech-powered, company dedicated to helping people make it simple and make it yours.

principles.title: Grassroots
principles.text: We never forget our humble beginnings; we’re relatable, down-to-earth, and part of the community.
principles.short: We never forget our humble beginnings; we’re relatable, down-to-earth and part of the community.

principles.title: Agile
principles.text: Agility is our x-factor. We are constantly improving, endlessly testing, always adapting.
principles.short: Agility is our x-factor. We are constantly improving, endlessly testing, always adapting.

principles.title: Pioneering
principles.text: Since the beginning, we’ve blazed a path and never settled, because that’s what it takes to make life better and easier.
principles.short: Since the beginning, we’ve blazed a path and never settled because that’s what it takes to make life better and easier.
